protocol: Metadata-only source triage of published Movebank DSpace Data packages; no original animal event/timestamp outcome data inspected.

rulebook.gps_gsm_keyword: \bGPS\b or GSM telemetry or global positioning, case-insensitive, in source title+subject tags only
rulebook.satellite_argos_keyword: Argos, satellite telemetry or satellite tracking in source title+subject tags
rulebook.light_geolocator_keyword: geolocator, light-level, solar geolocation in source title+subject tags

classes.gps_only: GPS/GSM metadata hint, no satellite or light keyword
classes.mixed_gps_other: GPS/GSM metadata hint plus satellite and/or geolocator keyword
classes.light_no_gps_sat: Light-geolocation hint without GPS/GSM or satellite
classes.unresolved_sensor: No selected keyword; NOT proven absence of GPS

rulebook.weights: Outcome-blind source-file inspection priority score = 30*GPS +8*CC0 +4*CCBY +7*local-ecology keyword -2*migration keyword -10*coarse-only -15*light-only; this is a work queue, NOT species selection or biological evidence
rulebook.audit_scope: Main GPS CSV rows, IDs, seasons, precision and repeated sessions are all UNVERIFIED unless separately demonstrated; reference-only pilot not counted as analytic eligibility.

interpretation_boundaries: Metadata GPS/GSM hints can misidentify actual sensor precision or readout; verify timestamp+coordinates main files before any inclusion.
The 437 DOI Data packages are not 437 independent species/populations or 437 repeated tracking datasets. Splits/versions and tags require deduplication.
Missing GPS keyword does NOT imply there are no GPS data; every unknown candidate remains eligible for inspection.
CC BY and CC BY-NC records are not simply scientifically excluded; reuse requires source attribution/terms review.
Migration/geolocator source data may support coarser spatiotemporal individuality but not physical 500-m co-use; do not pool resolutions.
The triage registry uses NO outcome measures and therefore cannot support positive ecological hypotheses. It is a metadata completeness and audit work queue.
